messages:
maya: Quick FYI — catalog launch scheduled for next Tue EOD. We’re gating on licensing + perf profiles for three open models: orion-7b, zephyr-lite, tanuki-3b. Please call out owners and any blockers.
catalog-bot: Checklist created: [license docs] [perf profiles] [canary route] — https://redwood-internal/catalyst/checklist/337 :robot_face:
ashish: I can take orion-7b perf profiling (typo: meant ashish). Planning microbench on NV4A and A100. Perf harness PR: github.com/redwood-inference/model-perf/pull/112
ashish: Quick note: will run `batch_size=1..8` seq=128..512, measure p50/p95 and memory.
sarah (legal): For zephyr-lite we still need the upstream license scan + CLA confirmation. @ashish can you paste the model source URL or the provider contact so legal can ping upstream? I can do a fast triage today.
liam: Infra note — when profiling, please set `pin_memory=true` and include `--num-warmups 50`. I saw a memory cliff on A100 at seq=1024 with 32-bit kernels; filed infra issue #987.
jordan: I’ll wire up the canary route and rollout flags. Plan: traffic=5% -> dedicated -> 25% after 2h if metrics ok. Created PR: github.com/redwood-inference/route-configs/pull/45
maya: TL;DR action items: ashish -> orion perf; sarah -> zephyr legal review; jordan -> canary route; liam -> infra checklist + run X on nv4a. Need owner for tanuki-3b embeddings shape (embedding dims + dtype). Volunteers?
ashish: I can take tanuki embeddings shape too. Quick Q — tanuki tokenizer is non-standard, do we canonicalize to an HF tokenizer or keep vendor tokenizer? cc @jordan
jordan: canonicalize to HF where possible. Add manifest field "tokenizer": "hf-bpe-v2". I’ll add that to the manifest PR.
sarah (legal): Zephyr license shows MIT + patent clause flagged by scanner. I’ll add a legal note to the model catalog doc with recommended mitigations and link to PRs. ETA: EOD today.
liam: Ran quick microbench on NV4A: orion-7b, seq=512 -> p50=48ms p95=120ms, mem=9.6GB. Jitter observed when sustained qps>200. Results posted: github.com/redwood-inference/model-perf/issues/334
maya: Can we schedule a smoke run tomorrow at 10:00am PST? Need infra + devex present for canary wiring and dashboards. I’ll create calendar invite.
ashish: Sounds good — I’ll prep harness and sample prompts in `/infra/perf-run/537654` and tag logs with `run=catalog-smoke-1`.
jordan: Canary route PR created and dashboard panel added: dashboards/model-canary (panel id 42). Will add alert if latency p95 > 300ms or error rate > 0.5%.
maya: Thanks team. I’ll update the checklist and bump priority for any open legal/perf items. Please respond in-thread once you hit your item so I can mark it done. :thumbsup:
catalog-bot: Checklist updated by maya — remaining items: zephyr-legal, tanuki-emb-shape. Reaction :white_check_mark:.
